diaspora_bullets: Confirm MMR vaccination for children and travelling relatives before holiday travel
47 jurisdictions have reported cases, with 18 cases among international visitors
news_summary: The CDC counted 6,039 confirmed measles cases in the United States in 2026 as of November 24, more than the 2,289 cases reported in all of 2025, with nine deaths counted so far.
payoff: The CDC advises families to confirm every household member's MMR vaccination status before holiday travel.
